_comment: Per-sprite render metadata, keyed by the same id used in game.js's images{} map. anchor.x/anchor.y are fractions (0-1) of the RAW image's own width/height, marking which point of the image should sit on the floor tile's target grid corner. scale corrects for sprites whose cutout has extra transparent padding. _room holds the plate's grid origin (originPx, the pixel location of grid (0,0)) plus gridN/tileW/tileH so the whole projection can be tuned from tools/anchor_editor.html without touching game.js.
